Manager.Name: Languages
Manager.Label: Manage Languages
Manager.Hint: Define the languages and set which ones each character knows.
Manager.DefinitionsHint: One per line: id | Label | sound style | universal (optional). The style sets how the words sound (elvish, dwarvish, giant, gnomish, goblin, halfling, orc, abyssal, celestial, deep, draconic, infernal, primordial, sylvan, undercommon, druidic, cant, sign).
Manager.PreviewSample: Greetings, brave adventurer! The dragon sleeps in the mountain.
Manager.ActorsHint: Languages from the character sheet are loaded automatically. Add extra language ids (comma separated) in the field below each name.
Manager.ExtraPlaceholder: Extra language ids, e.g. elvish, deep

GMSeesAll.Name: GM understands every language
GMSeesAll.Hint: GMs always see the original text.
